containment_proposal: Isolate WS-SALES-12, FS-HR-01 and DB-SRV-03; disable and reset m.chen, svc_deploy and db_admin credentials
expected_findings: Phishing email delivered a credential harvester link to m.chen and credentials were POSTed to 203.0.113.90
Stolen credentials were used for an external interactive logon on WS-SALES-12
LSASS memory was dumped on WS-SALES-12 (comsvcs MiniDump) and an internal port scan followed
Lateral movement over SMB ADMIN$ installed a remote service on FS-HR-01
db_admin SSH access to DB-SRV-03 came from WS-SALES-12, followed by an authorized_keys entry and sudo to root
narrative: Phishing harvest of m.chen credentials, external logon, LSASS dump on the workstation, SMB lateral movement to FS-HR-01, then SSH lateral movement to DB-SRV-03 with key persistence, root escalation and second-hop attempts.
